uid=u_abc123, ip=192.168.1.12", requestId: "req_7f2a1c", attrs: { uid: "u_abc123", ip: "192.168.1.12", method: "password", duration_ms: 84, }, }, { id: "2", ts: "15:18:05.821", level: "warn", service: "db", message: "Slow query detected: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status='open' (1842ms) - uid=u_def456", requestId: "req_11aa0b", attrs: { uid: "u_def456", limit: 120, remaining: 18, window_s: 60, }, }, { id: "6", ts: "15:18:10.001", level: "error", service: "db", message: "Connection pool exhausted - 50/50 connections in use", requestId: "req_pool01", attrs: { pool: "primary", active: 50, idle: 0, waiting: 14, }, }, { id: "7", ts: "15:18:11.000", level: "info", service: "api", message: "GET /api/v2/user/profile 200 OK - 18ms", requestId: "req_44bcde", attrs: { route: "GET /api/v2/user/profile", status: 200, duration_ms: 18, cache: "HIT", }, }, { id: "8", ts: "15:18:09.211", level: "debug", service: "tracing", message: "Span 'checkout_flow' completed - duration=312ms, status=ok", requestId: "req_7f2a1c", attrs: { span: "checkout_flow", trace_id: "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736", duration_ms: 312, status: "ok", }, }, ] const LEVEL_META: Record< LogLevel, { icon: React.ElementType; className: string } > = { info: { icon: InfoIcon, className: "text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400", }, warn: { icon: AlertTriangleIcon, className: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400", }, error: { icon: AlertCircleIcon, className: "text-destructive", }, debug: { icon: BugIcon, className: "text-muted-foreground", }, } const SERVICES = Array.from(new Set(ENTRIES.map((e) => e.service))).sort() export default function LogsViewer({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const [levelFilter, setLevelFilter] = React.useState("all") const [serviceFilter, setServiceFilter] = React.useState("all") const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("") const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = React.useState(ENTRIES[2]!.id) const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false) const filtered = ENTRIES.filter((entry) => { if (levelFilter !== "all" && entry.level !== levelFilter) return false if (serviceFilter !== "all" && entry.service !== serviceFilter) return false if (query) { const q = query.toLowerCase() if ( !entry.message.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !entry.service.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !entry.requestId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ) { return false } } return true }) const selected = filtered.find((e) => e.id === selectedId) ?? filtered[0] ?? null const SelectedIcon = selected ? LEVEL_META[selected.level].icon : null async function copyPayload() { if (!selected) return const payload = { ts: selected.ts, level: selected.level, service: selected.service, requestId: selected.requestId, message: selected.message, attrs: selected.attrs, stack: selected.stack ?? null, } try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)) setCopied(true) window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500) } catch { /* ignore */ } } return (
